boundary: Local production Next.js standalone apps with synthetic in-memory API fixtures. The cache contract uses the real Go processor. This frontend evidence does not certify PostgreSQL, SMTP, S3/R2, Cloudflare, final HTTPS origins or target-server performance.

playwright.execution: One complete run of the installed Playwright CLI with one worker; every native JSON result was checked for passed status and retry=0.

visual.review: All six routes at desktop/mobile were reviewed. After the rail CSS correction, all twelve captures were regenerated and the affected desktop images were reviewed again.

fixes: Use platform-native paths in the standalone-path smoke test; its Windows-only expected separators failed on Ubuntu.
Upgrade the locked ESLint dependency js-yaml from 4.3.1 to 4.3.2 for GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh.

Replace vertical CJK rail text with horizontally rendered stacked labels; the tested Ubuntu Chromium font fallback gave vertical glyphs zero height and overlapped the text. The existing desktop browser scenario now asserts nonzero, nonoverlapping text boxes.
Write media-delivery browser screenshots through Playwright outputPath instead of overwriting a hard-coded historical evidence file.
execution_notes: Sandbox child-process I/O returned EPERM; affected checks passed when executed with approved sandbox escalation.
The initial Go cache-contract attempt timed out during cold dependency/compilation work; after dependency download and compilation warm-up, all nine checks passed.

Two npm-wrapped E2E attempts ended with SIGTERM at different positions without assertion failures. The final direct-CLI run completed all 82 tests; a signal-only observer recorded no termination signal. The earlier signal source remains unconfirmed.

generated_data_removed: Rail-layout diagnostic screenshot and signal trace
